title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: stale #include removed from coap_server.c may cause build failure
description: In coap_server.c, the commit removes #include <lichen/oscore.h> and #include <lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h>. However, msg_inbox_oscore_respond() and the OSCORE-protected response path still pass 'struct oscore_ctx *' parameters (coap_server.c:126). If lichen/oscore.h defined or forward-declared struct oscore_ctx, removing this include could cause an incomplete type error unless lichen/coap_oscore.h (which remains included) itself includes lichen/oscore.h. Verify that lichen/coap_oscore.h includes lichen/oscore.h (it does at line 16), but also confirm lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h is no longer needed. This is a build-safety concern.
